releases.name: Gazeora v1.0.2-rc.1
releases.body:
## What's Changed
* Fix security vulnerabilities in the driver install and network stream by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/5
* feat: always capture games launched from the launcher by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/6
* feat: navigate the launcher with a game controller by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/7
* style: make the launcher easier to read by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/8
* feat: mark gazeora's window in the stream and drop the logo idle picture by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/9
* chore: remove hand gestures (work in progress) by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/10
* ci: replace the weekly run with a weekly patch pre-release by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/11
* feat: take the phone's hand pointer input in vr by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/12
* docs: offer gazeora under a commercial license as well as the gpl by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/13
* feat: turn the game camera with head tracking by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/14
* feat: show the phone camera status in the stream overlay by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/15
* feat: add a cmake option to leave out the stream overlay by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/16
* docs: rewrite the readme and guides against the code by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/17
* fix: drop the stale capture hint from the head tracking card by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/18
* fix: install the guides in a docs folder beside the readme by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/19
* feat: add a report a problem button by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/20
* feat: check for updates and install them from the launcher by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/21
* feat: remove games with missing exe files at startup by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/22
* feat: add plugins and a plugins page by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/23
* feat: game controllers as a bundled plugin, with XML plugin cards by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/24
* refactor: each bundled plugin in its own folder, with leak and hot-path fixes by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/25
* docs: plugin development guide, example plugin and architecture diagrams by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/26
* feat: install and uninstall plugins without restarting Gazeora by @NithinAashikPS in https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/pull/27


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/compare/v1.0.1-rc.1...v1.0.2-rc.1

releases.name: Gazeora v1.0.1-rc.1
releases.body:
A patch release candidate of Gazeora for Windows. The app is the same as v1.0.0-rc.1; this release is the first to reach [gazeora.github.io](https://gazeora.github.io/download.html) the moment it's published.

This is a pre-release. Please try it with your games and [report what you find](https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/issues/new/choose).

## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `Gazeora-v1.0.1-rc.1-x64.msi` | 64-bit games (most games from the last decade) |
| `Gazeora-v1.0.1-rc.1-x86.msi` | 32-bit games, including every Direct3D 8 game and many older Direct3D 9 and OpenGL ones |

Windows 10 or 11. Installs over v1.0.0-rc.1, keeping your library and settings. To watch on your phone, get [Gazeora for Android](https://gazeora.github.io/download.html).

## What changed since v1.0.0-rc.1

- Every release is now sent to the website as it's published, edited or deleted, with its files and checksums.
- The release steps in the development guide describe this.

See the [guides](https://gazeora.github.io/docs.html) to get started.

releases.name: Gazeora v1.0.0-rc.1
releases.body:
The first release candidate of Gazeora v1.0.0: a game launcher for Windows that captures your game as it renders and streams it live to your phone or any device on your network, flat or as a VR screen.

This is a pre-release. Please try it with your games and [report what you find](https://github.com/Gazeora/Gazeora/issues/new/choose) before v1.0.0.

## Downloads

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `Gazeora-v1.0.0-rc.1-x64.msi` | 64-bit games (most games from the last decade) |
| `Gazeora-v1.0.0-rc.1-x86.msi` | 32-bit games, including every Direct3D 8 game and many older Direct3D 9 and OpenGL ones |

The two install side by side. Windows 10 or 11. v1.0.0 will install over this version, keeping your library and settings.

## What's in it

- **Frame capture** from Direct3D 8, 9, 10, 11, 12 and OpenGL games, kept on the GPU from capture to encoder.
- **Live streaming** over RTSP (TCP or UDP), MPEG-TS over HTTP, UDP or USB, in H.264 or H.265 on the GPU's encoder (NVENC, AMF or Quick Sync), at a steady 60 fps.
- **VR viewer mode** with lens correction for Cardboard-style viewers, and **3D from depth** in Direct3D 11 and 12 games.
- **Hand gestures** from a webcam, and **touch from the phone** to control the launcher.
- **Game library** with Steam launching, play time and **Open with Gazeora** in Explorer.
- **MSI installer** with a firewall rule for private networks, an optional desktop shortcut and `GazeoraCLI` on PATH.

See the [guides](https://gazeora.github.io/docs.html) to get started.
